newsitem.title: POLAND: Two banks underwrite Amerbank new issue.
newsitem.headline: Two banks underwrite Amerbank new issue.

text.p: Polish Powszechny Bank Kredytowy SA (PBK) and Bank Przemyslowo-Handlowy (BPH) underwrote 800,000 shares of a 1.5-million new share issue of Polish Bank Amerykanski w Polsce SA (Amerbank), Amerbank said on Wednesday.
It said in a statement the stand-by fee was three percent of the value of the guaranteed shares.
It said PBK, which underwrote 700,000 shares, would get an additional seven percent discount on the first 350,000 shares it bought.
PBK would get a 7.5 percent discount if it bought 350,001 to 500,000 shares and eight percent if it bought 500,001 to 700,000 of the issue's shares.
It said BPH, which underwrote 100,000 shares, would get an additional seven percent discount if had to buy the shares.
Amerbank earlier set its issue price at 21 zlotys per share.
The issue will be offered from September 23 to September 27 and will be valid if at least 600,000 shares are sold.
